title: [AUG-195] Research: Active project session — precise mockups of the ASSISTANT overlay (P1) and the persistent `claude -p` session design
why_we_need_this: AUG-193 agreed: one persistent `claude -p --input-format stream-json` child process per (recording, Praxis project), shown as a right overlay «ASSISTANT» (P1) with project tabs, Praxis reached by Claude through its own MCP config, action items added through a small August MCP server. The user wants precise mockups of the panel in every state before implementation, and the process design must be verified against the real constraint: the user has no API key, Claude Code is signed in through the browser (OAuth). Source: @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md, @docs/mockups/AUG-193/assistant-panel.html.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Precise HTML mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-195/assistant-overlay.html, self-contained, on August's real tokens (overlay glass style of ControlsPanel AUG-154, 0 border-radius): pin bar [ SESSIONS ] [ CONTROLS ] [ ASSISTANT ], overlay 420 px with project chips (praxisProjects, Recent from AUG-192, Open…), tabs per project, chat log (user, assistant streaming, tool chips), input, «→ Action item» and «→ Praxis task» on a message, footer with spending so far / limit; states: no project yet, one project, two projects, PraxisOS not running, Claude Code missing/not signed in, budget reached, child crashed and resumed; Compact Mode `CTX n` badge on Dock Strip and Ghost Caption.
- [ ] Prototype outside the product tree (scratch script) proves on Windows: a persistent `claude -p --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages` child spawned from Node with cwd = a Praxis project, `--strict-mcp-config --mcp-config` (Praxis http + a stub August http MCP), `--tools Read,Grep,Glob`, `--allowedTools`, `--permission-prompts none`, `--setting-sources ""`, `--max-budget-usd`, `--session-id` + `--resume` after a kill — works under the browser (OAuth) login with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; turn latencies and per-turn cost recorded; macOS run recorded or explicitly marked pending with the keychain question.
- [ ] Message contract written: WebSocket frames (assistant-start/ask/stop, assistant-status/delta/message), the August MCP server tools (get_recent_transcript, list_action_items, add_action_item with the similarity-0.6 dedup and the `assistant` item field), REST mirror POST /api/live/:liveKey/action-items, lifecycle rules (spawn on first question, idle stop 10 min, stop on End Meeting, max 3 children, LRU).
- [ ] System prompt for the child drafted (meeting assistant, answer in the meeting's language, create tasks only via Praxis create_task, note items via add_action_item, never edit files) and the transcript hand-off format (<recent_transcript window=N min>) specified.
- [ ] Decision recorded after the user reviews the mockup (AskUserQuestion); CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with SMART criteria and a link to the final mockup is created; its ID is written here and into the M4 roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no product code; prototypes live outside the product tree. Direction decided in AUG-193: persistent stream-json child, P1 overlay, Claude's own MCP to Praxis; do not re-open one-shot `claude -p` or P2/P3. No API key: the user authenticates Claude Code through the browser, so `--bare` is out. Transcript leaves the machine only inside a question turn and only with the consent from the Settings task. Cross-platform per @CLAUDE.md. Roadmap: M4 AI assistants.

Order: 2/3. Depends on: AUG-194-hinr8y (toggle, consent, status shape). Blocks: AUG-196-gxk1pv (the copilot explanation turn runs through this session). Parent research: AUG-193-bj5mw1.
